title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
About Us
Riskified empowers businesses to unleash ecommerce growth by taking risk off the table. Many of the world’s biggest brands and publicly traded companies selling online rely on Riskified for guaranteed protection against chargebacks, to fight fraud and policy abuse at scale, and to improve customer retention. Developed and managed by the largest team of ecommerce risk analysts, data scientists and researchers, Riskified’s AI-powered fraud and risk intelligence platform analyzes the individual behind each interaction to provide real-time decisions and robust identity-based insights. Riskified is proud to work with incredible companies in virtually all industries including Acer, Gucci, Lorna Jane, GoPro, and many more .
We thrive in a collaborative work setting, alongside great people, to build and enhance products that matter. Abundant opportunities to create and contribute provide us with a sense of purpose that extends beyond ourselves, leaving a lasting impact. These sentiments capture why we choose Riskified every day.
About the Role
The Account Affinity team owns Riskified’s Identity domain. We build the systems that figure out who is really behind an order: linking accounts, devices, emails, and payment details into a single view of each customer across thousands of eCommerce merchants.
Our main product, Identity Engine, resolves and clusters identities in near real time and feeds them into Riskified’s fraud and risk decisions. We also build data platform services that give other teams a richer view of each customer.
What You'll Be Doing
• Build identity infrastructure: Design, build, and run high-throughput services that resolve and cluster identities in near real time.
• Build data platforms: Develop large-scale data pipelines and the APIs that expose them to teams across Riskified.
• Work across teams: Partner with Product, Data Science, and consuming teams to turn their requirements into clear, well-defined data contracts and services.
• Own production: Ship continuously, and take end-to-end ownership of the reliability, performance, and data correctness of your services.
• Use modern workflows: Use AI coding assistants and agentic tools day to day to move faster and raise code quality.
• Shape the roadmap: Contribute to team planning, design reviews, and technical direction.
Qualifications
• B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent experience
• 3+ years of hands-on backend development
• Proven experience building distributed systems and microservices on cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP)
• Experience with streaming or event-driven architectures (Kafka or similar)
• Experience with a JVM language (Scala, Java, or Kotlin). Scala is an advantage
• Experience with large-scale data processing (Spark, Databricks, or similar) is an advantage
• Experience with graph data, entity resolution, or identity systems is an advantage
• Background in fraud, risk, fintech, or eCommerce is an advantage
• Comfortable using AI coding assistants and agentic tools in daily work
• Independent learner, proactive problem solver, and a strong team player
We include transparent salary ranges to support fairness, clarity, and informed decision-making early in the process. The base salary range for this position is €€50,000 - €75,000 gross annually for candidates based in Lisbon. Your actual salary will be determined based on your unique skills, experience, and competencies. If your expectations differ, please let us know - we’re always open to a conversation.
The base salary is one part of the total compensation package at Riskified. All full-time regular employees receive a bonus target and are eligible to receive stock-based awards. Also, our value proposition goes way beyond compensation: our perks and benefits package, culture, community, and learning and development programs are just some of the elements we provide to bring value to our employees.
Life at Riskified
We are a fast-growing and dynamic tech company with 750+ team members globally. We value collaboration and innovative thinking.
We’re looking for bright, driven, and passionate people to grow with us.
Some of our Lisbon Benefits & Perks:
• Hybrid mode of work
• Flexible schedule
• Healthcare benefits
• Fully-stocked kitchens
• Benefits package per month—per your choice, e.g., work-from-home equipment, gym membership, wellbeing activities, and more.
• Wellness program
• Celebrations and activities
• Team events
• Happy hours
• Awesome Riskified gifts and swags
• Volunteer programs
• Personal development
• Global onboarding
• Role-based technical skills training
• Full access to Udemy
In the News
C-Tech: We need to find the balance between leveraging innovative AI solutions and using them cautiously
Built In: How We Built This: A Riskified Technologist Unpacks The Company’s Beacon Technology
Globes: Riskified is among Israel’s fastest growing companies
Yahoo: Riskified Earns "Top Rated" Award Across Four TrustRadius Solution Categories
Riskified is deeply committed to the principle of equal opportunity for all individuals. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by law.

title: Solutions Architect, Onchain Compliance - EMEA
description:
BUILD A SAFER WORLD.

TRM Labs provides AI-powered intelligence solutions that help public and private sector agencies investigate and disrupt crime. TRM's platforms enable investigators to trace illicit activity, build cases, and construct operating pictures of threat networks. Leading agencies and businesses worldwide rely on TRM to make the world safer and more secure.

As a Solutions Architect on TRM's Onchain Compliance  - EMEA team, you are the technical owner of the sales cycle for crypto exchanges, banks, fintechs, and payments companies. You partner with Account Directors from the first discovery call through close, then stay close as customers integrate and go live. You turn a compliance team's requirements into an architecture they trust and a pilot that proves it.

The impact you will have:

 - Own the technical win on strategic onchain compliance deals, using TRM's platform and AI-assisted workflows to turn each customer's compliance process into an architecture they trust. This directly determines whether TRM lands and keeps tier 1 accounts.

 - Compress time to value by building tailored, AI-assisted demos within days of discovery, showing compliance teams how TRM plus AI cuts manual alert review.

 - Design and prove API integrations that fit real compliance operations, including alert triage, case management, and escalation, and use AI tooling to prototype them quickly.

 - Build reusable, AI-enabled demo and integration assets so every deal moves faster than the last and the team scales without adding manual work.

 - Feed field insight back to Product and Engineering, shaping the roadmap so TRM stays ahead of what compliance teams need next.

What we’re looking for:

 - 5+ years in pre- and post-sales technical roles (Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, Solutions Engineer, or Customer Success Engineer), increasingly using AI tools in your workflow.

 - Hands-on experience scoping, implementing, and supporting API-based SaaS integrations, including using AI to prototype and test them faster.

 - Comfort with REST APIs and scripting in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript, and with AI coding assistants to build quick prototypes.

 - Familiarity with AML, KYC, sanctions screening, or transaction monitoring, and interest in applying AI to speed compliance review.

 - Daily use of AI tools with the judgment to know when to trust the output and when to verify it.

 - Strong discovery, prioritization across several opportunities at once, and clear communication with both engineers and senior compliance leaders.

 - Bonus: blockchain fundamentals, crypto compliance regulation, or experience building AI-enabled workflows. If you are excited by the mission but do not check every box, we encourage you to apply.

About the Team:

 - Solutions Architecture at TRM is a globally distributed, fully remote team that works asynchronously through Slack and detailed documentation.

 - The team is on the front lines of TRM: trusted technical advisors to customers and a primary source of customer insight for Product and Engineering.

 - The work is intellectually demanding. You translate complex compliance and blockchain problems into clear solutions under real deal pressure.

 - Expect high ownership and pace. You run your opportunities end to end and are trusted to make the technical call.

Team Operating Rhythms:

 - Weekly customer syncs, bi-weekly health syncs, and account POD calls, with regular direct customer engagement.

 - Async-first communication through Slack and written documentation. Distributed, not distant.

 - Travel 20 to 30 percent for customer meetings and onsite sessions.

On-Call Responsibilities:

 - Schedule: No formal on-call rotation.

 - Frequency: Occasional off-hours escalations for live customer incidents (HM to confirm at intake).

Travel Requirements:

 - Schedule: As needed for customer meetings and onsite sessions.

 - Frequency: 20 to 30 percent.

Onsite Requirements:

 - Schedule: Occasional customer onsite visits.

 - Frequency: HM to confirm at intake.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

 - Within days of discovery, you put a demo built around the customer's compliance workflow in front of them, not a generic walkthrough.

 - Within days of a customer's commitment, you have agreed success criteria and a live pilot environment.

 - In the first 90 days, you build reusable demo and integration assets that cut setup time on the next deal.


APPLICATION INSTRUCTIONS

If you’re interested in joining TRM, we encourage you to apply directly. Every application is reviewed by our Talent team.

Before applying, review the job description carefully and highlight the experience and impact that best demonstrate the required qualifications. Please also provide thoughtful and accurate answers to the application questions, as these will be used to evaluate your skills and qualifications for the role.

If you send your resume directly to someone at TRM, we can’t guarantee it will reach the appropriate hiring team. Applying directly is the best way to ensure your application will be considered.




INTERVIEWING WITH TRM

Our process is designed to understand how you think, solve problems, and deliver impact, while allowing you to evaluate TRM. Most interview processes include a case study, an AI skills assessment, and a Leadership Principles interview.

 - Recruiter Intro: Qualifications, motivations, and alignment with the role.

 - Hiring Manager: Deep dive into your relevant experience, skills, and impact.

 - First Round: 1–2 interviews focused on the skills most critical to the role.

 - Final Round: Hands-on case study. This is usually a panel-style session where we go deeper into your craft, problem-solving, and alignment with TRM.

 - References: Former colleagues who can provide insight into your work and impact.

 - Offer: Congrats! Your recruiter will present the offer and compensation details.

title: Software Engineer - Interfaces Backend
description:
ABOUT SUPABASE

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Software Engineer to join Supabase’s Interfaces group and help run the backend services behind our developer tools, starting with postgres-meta: the open-source service that runs SQL against customers’ Postgres databases on behalf of our dashboard, our MCP server, AI agents, and other platform tools. You’ll work closely with the engineers who build those tools, and with our Platform and SRE teams.

AI agents are the fastest-growing source of postgres-meta’s traffic, and it sits on the path between developers and their data, so when it struggles, people can’t reach their databases from the dashboard or their agents. The team’s first priority is making it reliable, observable, and fair between tenants at agent scale, and helping redesign it for that scale without breaking the tools that depend on it. Depending on your experience, you’ll own major parts of that work or lead it. Alongside it, the team builds the backend services that give every branch of a project the configuration and secrets it needs.

We want to be upfront: this role carries real operational load. Our on-call process and rotation are new and need a lot of maturing, and you’ll help build them into something sustainable from your first weeks. You’ll be on call for services on the critical path, and incidents come before planned work. Platform teams run the infrastructure underneath; you’ll own the services themselves, from their code to how they behave in production. It’s ideal for someone who enjoys that kind of ownership, thrives in async, fast-paced environments, and stays calm when the root cause turns out to be in someone else’s system.



WHAT YOU’LL BE RESPONSIBLE FOR

In this role, you’ll:

 - Help mature the team’s on-call from your first weeks: grow the rotation to cover every service the team runs, write runbooks, and agree when to declare an incident. Then build it, with our embedded SRE, into a sustainable follow-the-sun rotation as the team grows.

 - Set SLOs with the teams that call the service, and build the observability to hold them: metrics per tenant and per caller, alerts that catch failures wherever they start, and logs you can search across regions.

 - Make deploys routine with canary and staged rollouts, so dependency and security upgrades stop being risky.

 - Redesign how the service works with Postgres at scale: reusing connections, limiting or streaming large results, and isolating and rate-limiting tenants, so no single caller, human or agent, can degrade it for everyone else.

 - Help decide the service’s long-term architecture with our Platform teams, then evolve it without breaking the callers that depend on it.

 - Write down and agree the service’s contract with its callers, including the dashboard, MCP and AI, and platform workers: how transactions, multi-statement queries, timeouts, and errors behave.

 - Work through incidents with the networking, Kubernetes, pooler, and control-plane teams when a problem on the path to customers’ databases starts in their systems.

 - Build backend services for code-first workflows, starting with delivering each branch’s configuration and secrets to the services that need them.

 - Make small changes directly in the CLI, dashboard, or docs when a capability needs them, with the owning team reviewing.

 - Review code and designs, mentor other engineers, and grow into leading the team’s technical direction.
   


YOU MIGHT BE A GOOD FIT IF YOU

Must have:

 - Have 5+ years of experience as a software engineer, most of it building and running backend services in production.

 - Have run a high-traffic, multi-tenant service in production: been on call for it, worked incidents through to resolution, and followed through on postmortems.

 - Write strong TypeScript, and work confidently in a large Node.js backend codebase.

 - Understand Postgres from the client side: connection management and pooling, transactions, statement timeouts and cancellation, and large result sets.

 - Have built observability for a service you owned (metrics, tracing, logs, and alerts tied to SLOs), and used it to debug problems that span proxies, load balancers, or Kubernetes.

 - Have kept a service healthy under load with patterns such as rate limiting, timeouts, memory limits, and graceful degradation.

 - Have shipped changes to a live service safely, with canaries, staged rollouts, feature flags, or fast rollback.

 - Work calmly and constructively with other teams during incidents, including when the root cause is in a system you don’t own.

 - Communicate clearly in writing, from design docs to postmortems, thrive in async, globally distributed teams, and make progress when the path isn’t fully defined.

Nice to have, roughly in order of how much they’d help:

 - Have rebuilt or migrated a live, high-traffic service without breaking its callers, using techniques such as shadow traffic, contract tests, or incremental replacement.

 - Have led the design of reliability work, such as tenant isolation, load shedding, or a staged-deploy pipeline, or set technical direction that other engineers built on.

 - Have built or operated a database proxy or connection pooler (such as PgBouncer, Supavisor, or pgcat), or an API gateway such as Envoy.

 - Have secured a service that runs SQL on its callers’ behalf: handling credentials safely, and limiting how much damage any one caller can do.

 - Multi-region AWS experience.

 - Experience with Fastify.

 - Production experience in a second backend language, such as Elixir or Go.

 - Experience with a secrets manager or key management service, such as HashiCorp Vault or AWS KMS.

 - Familiarity with Supabase, or with how AI

title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform Billing Core
description:
Elastic, the Search AI Company, enables everyone to find the answers they need in real time, using all their data, at scale — unleashing the potential of businesses and people. The Elastic Search AI Platform, used by more than 50% of the Fortune 500, brings together the precision of search and the intelligence of AI to enable everyone to accelerate the results that matter. By taking advantage of all structured and unstructured data — securing and protecting private information more effectively — Elastic’s complete, cloud-based solutions for search, security, and observability help organizations deliver on the promise of AI.
What Is The Role :
Billing powers Elastic's Cloud business. It runs across AWS, GCP, and Azure in over 50 regions. We oversee usage-based metering, consumption billing, and marketplace integrations at global scale.
The Billing Core team owns the data layer that makes billing correct, auditable, and automated. We work across two areas:
•
Usage — Collect and process usage and cost data. This data is the foundation of our billing and financial reporting.
•
Engine — Turn hourly usage data into customer invoices and revenue records.
We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join the Billing Core team. You will take ownership of key systems, solve complex problems with minimal guidance, and help raise the bar for engineering quality on the team. You will work closely with Product, SRE, and Cloud Infrastructure teams.
What You Will Be Doing :
•
Own and improve billing data pipelines for usage ingestion, transformation, and reconciliation.
•
Design and build reliable, scalable backend services in Python, with a focus on correctness and data integrity.
•
Take ownership of Elasticsearch and PostgreSQL schema design and query performance for billing data.
•
Lead small to medium projects end-to-end — from design to delivery — within the team.
•
Improve observability and reliability of core billing systems through better monitoring, alerting, and incident response.
•
Participate in code and design reviews. Be a trusted reviewer for your area of the stack.
•
Mentor junior engineers through feedback, pairing, and design discussions.
•
Work with Product and Tech Leads to help shape priorities and technical direction.
•
Take part in on-call rotations and contribute to production readiness.
What You Bring :
•
5+ years in backend engineering, with solid skills in Python and production experience with data stores and storage systems (schema design, query performance, reliability).
•
Experience building and operating data pipelines or event-driven systems in a production environment.
•
Knowledge with large-scale data processing and storage technologies, such as Spark, AWS Glue and Athena, Iceberg, and Parquet.
•
Solid understanding of distributed systems and how to build for reliability and scale.
•
Background in cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure) — networking, monitoring, and deployment basics.
•
Strong judgment in technical trade-offs. You can work through ambiguous problems and deliver well-thought-out solutions.
•
Good communication skills. You write clearly and speak up in discussions to share your perspective.
•
Experience with SaaS billing, metering, or financial systems is a plus.
•
Knowledge with PostgreSQL or Elasticsearch is a plus.
•
Comfortable working in a global, distributed, async environment.
•
Track record of using AI to improve development practices, including design, development, and debugging, while continuing to own the outcomes.
Compensation for this role is in the form of base salary. This role does not have a variable compensation component.
At Elastic, our compensation philosophy aims to provide fair, competitive and transparent remuneration. Salary ranges are established based on a combination of external market benchmarks, internal pay equity considerations, and the responsibilities and complexity associated with each role. This approach helps ensure consistency across comparable roles while remaining competitive within the relevant labour markets.
The final compensation offered within the applicable range will be determined based on several objective factors, including relevant professional experience, level of skills and expertise, alignment with the role requirements, and the overall scope and complexity of the position.
The typical starting salary range for this role is:
€55.800 — €88.300 EUR
Additional Information - We Take Care of Our People
As a distributed company, diversity drives our identity. Whether you’re looking to launch a new career or grow an existing one, Elastic is the type of company where you can balance great work with great life. Your age is only a number. It doesn’t matter if you’re just out of college or your children are; we need you for what you can do.
We strive to have parity of benefits across regions and while regulations differ from place to place, we believe taking care of our people is the right thing to do.
• Competitive pay based on the work you do here and not your previous salary
• Health coverage for you and your family in many locations
• Ability to craft your calendar with flexible locations and schedules for many roles
• Generous number of vacation days each year
• Increase your impact - We match up to $2000 (or local currency equivalent) for financial donations and service
• Up to 40 hours each year to use toward volunteer projects you love
• Embracing parenthood with minimum of 16 weeks of parental leave
Different people approach problems differently. We need that. Elastic is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive culture that celebrates different perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. title: Senior Software Engineer, Back-end, (Fraud)

description:
At Affirm, we exist for the moments that matter—giving people a clear, predictable way to pay over time, with no hidden fees, no surprises, and no tradeoffs on what matters most.
The Fraud Engineering organization builds the foundational and tactical software that enables Affirm to respond strategically to fraud - both in real time and after the transaction. Our mission is to support business growth while protecting Affirm, our buyers, and our merchants. We evaluate risk at critical decision points in the user journey, rapidly adapt to evolving fraud patterns, and equip operations teams with the tools needed to investigate and mitigate fraud at scale.
We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our fully remote team based in Europe. You’ll collaborate closely with stakeholders across North America - including teams in Product, Compliance, Machine Learning, Fraud Operations, Fraud Strategy, and other Fraud Engineering teams.
The Fraud Engineering organization builds the foundational and tactical software that enables Affirm to respond strategically to fraud - both in real time and after the transaction. Our mission is to support business growth while protecting Affirm, our customers, and our merchants. We evaluate risk at critical decision points in the user journey, rapidly adapt to evolving fraud patterns, and equip operations teams with the tools needed to investigate and mitigate fraud at scale.
The Fraud International Team (FIT) leads the engineering effort to extend Affirm's Fraud Decisioning System into markets beyond the US - Canada, the UK, Australia, and growing rapidly. We own real-time fraud decisioning for these markets, integrate region-specific risk vendors, and are building the platform that lets Affirm stand up fraud protection in a new country quickly and safely. As Affirm expands globally, FIT scales with it.
We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our fully remote team based in Europe. You'll collaborate closely with stakeholders across North America - including teams in Product, Compliance, Machine Learning, Fraud Operations, Fraud Strategy, and other Fraud Engineering teams.
What You'll Do
• You will own and deliver quarterly goals for your team, leading engineers through ambiguity to solve open-ended problems, and ensuring that everyone is supported throughout delivery.
• You will design and implement real-time fraud decisioning services and APIs in Python or Kotlin, extending Affirm's Fraud Decisioning System to markets beyond the US.
• You will build and evolve the platform and tooling that let Affirm launch fraud decisioning in a new country quickly—turning market-by-market setup (rules, models, and vendor configuration) into a repeatable, low-friction path so launches scale sub-linearly with the number of markets.
• You will integrate region-specific fraud and risk vendors and help operationalize the machine learning and AI signals that power real-time decisioning, while using modern AI tooling to move faster as an engineer.
• You will support peers and stakeholders across the product development lifecycle - collaborating with Product, Machine Learning, Analytics, and Fraud Strategy, articulating technical constraints, and partnering on decisions that properly weigh risks and trade-offs.
• You will support the operations and availability of your team's systems by creating and monitoring metrics, escalating when needed, and contributing to keep-the-lights-on and on-call efforts.
• You will foster a culture of quality and ownership - setting and improving code review and design standards, mentoring teammates, and leading by example.
• On-Call Rotation - There would be an on-call rotation for this role as a requirement.
What We Look For
• 5+ years of experience building backend systems at scale using Python or Kotlin.
• Experience with distributed systems and infrastructure using AWS, MySQL/PostgreSQL, and Kubernetes.
• Strong system design skills and a track record of delivering maintainable, extensible services.
• Fluency with AI-driven engineering - every Affirm engineer builds with tools like Claude Code and most PRs are co-authored with AI, so directing and orchestrating AI and excelling in the reviewer's seat (setting intent, critically evaluating generated code, and owning its correctness, quality, and security) is a core expectation.
• Proficiency in SQL and working with data-rich environments.
• Familiarity with CI/CD practices and safe production deployments.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, especially in distributed teams.
• A proactive, ownership-driven mindset with a focus on learning and team success.
• Experience with Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, or Chronosphere (nice to have)
• Background in fraud prevention, risk systems, or real-time decisioning (nice to have)
• Experience building for multiple markets or regions - internationalization or localization (nice to have)
• Experience working in the fintech sector or other highly regulated environments, with a strong understanding of risk, compliance, and operational constraints. (nice to have)
Compensation & Benefits
Base Pay Grade - N
Equity Grade - 4
Employees new to Affirm typically come in at the start of the pay range. Affirm focuses on providing a simple and transparent pay structure which is based on a variety of factors, including location, experience and job-related skills.
Base pay is part of a total compensation package that may include monthly stipends for health, wellness and tech spending, and benefits (including 100% subsidized medical coverage, dental and vision for you and your dependents). In addition, the employees may be eligible for equity rewards offered by Affirm Holdings, Inc. (parent company).
ESP base pay range per year: €86,000 - €122,000
Additional benefits include:
• Flexible Spending Wallets for tech, food and lifestyle
• Away Days - wellness days to take off work and recharge
• Learning & Development programs
• Parental benefits

title: Mid/Senior Backend Engineer - Ruby
description:
Sensor Tower’s digital intelligence platform provides unparalleled insight into market trends, advertising, competitor’s strategies, and consumer/user audience across mobile, web, and gaming. Sensor Tower’s insights are trusted by more than 2,500 enterprises worldwide across tech, retail/commerce, entertainment/media, gaming, consumer packaged goods and finance.



Role Summary:

From efficiently scaling database operations to supporting the growing amount of data (tens of terabytes), we're looking for engineers that have the creativity and skills to gather meaningful data and insights.

As an engineer at Sensor Tower, you will make sure we're building the best possible products and features to support our users. In our lean and flat organization, you will also have a meaningful say in what and how we build out all aspects of our product.



A Day in the Life:

Interviewee: Engineering Team Lead - Sasha Yelkovenka

 

What does your day to day look like working as a Software Engineer?

I work with tons of data and the volume of this data is constantly increasing. My job is to make sure our customers can access it as quickly as possible and provide them convenient tools for data consumption. I love the spirit of taking ownership of your work and product.

 

How do you collaborate with your team as a remote employee?

Sensor Tower has a great atmosphere of a distributed team. We often pair over zoom to combine our knowledge in order to achieve better results..



What You Will Do

 - Participate in the full development life cycle, including design, implementation, quality polish, and release.

 - Leverage your strengths and interests to work on full feature implementation from brainstorming the architecture design, all the way to the back end implementation and delivery to the customers.

 - Optimize endpoints that touch billions of rows in the database, by applying profiling to ruby code and understanding crucial performance details of ClickHouse queries.

 - Perform code reviews, and suggest improvements to tools and processes.

 - Work on challenging products like Top Apps, where each query basically analyzes the whole dataset.

 - Design API contracts that other teams can rely on, and evolve them without breaking existing consumers.

 - Be the go-to partner for front-end, product, data science and customer-facing teams building on these APIs. Understand what they need, push back when a request would make the API harder to reason about, and turn recurring questions into better docs.



Experience We Want To See

 - 3+ years of experience as a software engineer (If you have lesser years of experience but have meaningful github contributions and other coding samples, this will be taken into consideration).

 - Strong foundation in programming, algorithms, and software application design.

 - Good API design for query-heavy, data-intensive APIs.

 - You have an understanding of the basics of cloud environments, and ideally you’ve had some exposure to AWS.

 - Required: Ruby on Rails (or Python and willing to learn Ruby on Rails).

 - Nice to have: Clickhouse, MongoDB, Sidekiq.

 - A track record of independently driving projects from ambiguous requirements to release.



Our Engineering Culture

We believe that "Simplicity is a prerequisite for reliability." We are looking for engineers who align with our core values:

- Simplicity: We avoid over-engineering. We prefer the tools we already have and the most straightforward solutions over "shiny new toys."

- Quality: We write code that is a pleasure to read because we know code is written once but read many times. We don't cut corners, and we polish to a high level before shipping.

- Extreme Ownership: We don't just do the minimum. We expect you to understand the "why" behind your work and own the ultimate goal of fixing problems at their root cause, avoiding temporary band-aids.

- Prioritization: We focus relentlessly on what is important, not just what is urgent.



Read more about some of our Technical challenges here (written by members of our engineering team):

https://sensortower.com/blog/speeding-up-the-backend-with-graph-theory

https://sensortower.com/blog/how-we-scaled-to-thousands-of-sidekiq-workers





Fraud warning:

It's common for scammers to create positions that look legitimate on other sites. To ensure your submission is considered, only apply for positions at Sensor Tower through our company website or through posts directly associated with Sensor Tower company profiles on sites such as LinkedIn, Indeed, BuiltIn or Hackajob. At no point will Sensor Tower ever ask for money, credit card, or bank account information to complete a job application. Communications received from Sensor Tower are only sent by e-mail addresses ending in sensortower.com http://sensortower.com. All Sensor Tower interviews will be conducted via phone or Zoom. At no time will a conversation be moved to an alternative email outside of sensortower.com http://sensortower.com or text. Should an issue arise that you feel we should be aware of, please contact us. Please provide your resume when applying.



To all recruitment agencies:

Sensor Tower does not accept third party resumes. Please do not send resumes to our jobs alias, Sensor Tower employees or any other organization location. Sensor Tower is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes. Sensor Tower will not pay any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Sensor Tower.



We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Founding Harness Engineer
description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Build the agent runtime and reliability systems behind an AI coworker for teams. In this founding role, you will shape how tool-using agents take initiative, handle approvals, and complete useful work safely.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build the agent runtime for gathering context, deciding when to act, selecting tools, requesting approval, and completing work.

 - Write and refine system prompts that encourage useful initiative without noisy or unsafe behavior.

 - Build evaluation and regression tests around real tasks, tool use, and failure cases.

 - Improve reliability for long-running work, interruptions, and retries.

 - Implement safe execution boundaries, including approval gates and multi-tenant data separation.

 - Work directly with the founder and early users to shape the product.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 4 to 10+ years of relevant experience, including shipping tool-using LLM agents to production.

 - Hands-on experience designing and testing system prompts, and building agent evaluation and regression harnesses.

 - Experience with safe tool execution, approval gates, and multi-user or multi-tenant data separation.

 - Familiarity with agent runtimes that support long-running work, interruptions, and retries.

 - Strong ownership across prototyping and production, with the ability to explain technical tradeoffs.


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Founding equity is available; the percentage and vesting terms are to be confirmed. Local employment or contractor arrangements are also to be confirmed.


LOCATION

Fully remote from Serbia, Poland, or another Eastern European country. Working-hour overlap is to be confirmed.
